title: Cassava Flour (Fufu & Baking Powder)
description: High-quality cassava flour used to prepare traditional African dishes such as fufu and other regional specialties. A versatile staple ingredient enjoyed across Africa and worldwide.

descriptionI18n.en: High-quality cassava flour used to prepare traditional African dishes such as fufu and other regional specialties. A versatile staple ingredient enjoyed across Africa and worldwide.
descriptionI18n.fr: Farine de manioc de haute qualité utilisée pour préparer le fufu traditionnel et d'autres spécialités régionales. Un ingrédient de base polyvalent.
descriptionI18n.ru: Высококачественная мука из маниоки для приготовления традиционного африканского блюда фуфу и национальной выпечки. Натуральный традиционный продукт.
